# Vercel CLI command map (generated)

Discovery only: which commands exist, their aliases, and the global options.
This map is built from command registration metadata, unlike the CLI’s hand-maintained root help text, so it cannot list commands that do not exist.
For exact syntax (arguments, options, examples), run `vercel <command> --help` — the installed CLI is the syntax authority and is always version-correct.

## Global options

Accepted by every command, except where a command’s own `--help` says otherwise.

- `--cwd <DIR>` (string) — Sets the current working directory for a single run of a command
- `-d`, `--debug` (boolean) — Debug mode (default off)
- `-Q`, `--global-config <DIR>` (string) — Path to the global `.vercel` directory
- `-h`, `--help` (boolean) — Output usage information
- `-A`, `--local-config <FILE>` (string) — Path to the local `vercel.json` file
- `--no-color` (boolean) — No color mode (default off)
- `--non-interactive` (boolean) — Run without interactive prompts; when an agent is detected this is the default
- `-S`, `--scope` (string) — Set a custom scope
- `-t`, `--token <TOKEN>` (string) — Login token
- `-v`, `--version` (boolean) — Output the version number
